Habit is a small tool that helps you build good habits.\n\nCreate a habit plan, write down your belief and your reason. Add points when you complete it, deduct when you break it. See your persistence at a glance.

Habit Terms of Service
Last updated: November 15, 2026

1. Acceptance
Welcome to Habit ("the App"), developed and maintained by an independent developer, Wan. By downloading, installing or using the App you confirm that you have read and agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please stop using the App.

2. What the App does
2.1 The App is a local tool that helps you record and build habits: creating habit plans, recording completions and misses, accumulating points and unlocking achievements.
2.2 The current version requires no registration and provides no accounts or cloud sync.

3. Data and storage
3.1 Your habits, points and achievements are stored only on your own phone.
3.2 The App does not upload this data to any server and does not collect your personal information.
3.3 Uninstalling the App, clearing app data or switching devices permanently deletes that data. Please keep this in mind.

4. Points and achievements
4.1 Points and achievements are virtual records used only for self-motivation.
4.2 Points have no monetary value and cannot be exchanged for cash, goods or any other benefit.
4.3 You may clear achievements or delete your plans inside the App at any time.

5. Acceptable use
5.1 You agree to use the App lawfully and reasonably.
5.2 You must not reverse engineer, crack or modify the App, or use it for any illegal purpose.
5.3 You must not use the App to infringe the lawful rights of others.

6. Intellectual property
6.1 The interface design, icons and source code of the App belong to the developer.
6.2 Open source components follow their own licenses; see About - Open source licenses.

7. Disclaimer
7.1 The App is provided "as is"; the developer does not guarantee it is entirely free of errors.
7.8 The developer is not liable for data loss caused by device failure, system updates, mistakes or uninstallation.
7.3 The App is not a substitute for professional advice (medical, psychological, financial or otherwise).

8. Changes
The developer may update these terms occasionally. Updated terms are shown inside the App; continued use means acceptance.

9. Contact
Questions about these terms: wan.business@qq.com. If the address changes, the About page is the reference.

10. Miscellaneous
Any matter not covered here shall be settled in good faith by both parties.

Habit Privacy Policy
Last updated: November 15, 2026

1. What we collect
The App currently collects no personal information. All features work without registration, a phone number or an email address.

2. Where your data lives
Habits, points and achievements are stored only in the App private folder on your phone and are never uploaded to any server.

3. Network and third parties
3.1 The App contains no analytics, advertising or crash-reporting SDK.
3.2 The only external access is the developer contact links on the About page, which open a browser or mail app only when you tap them.

4. Permissions
The App does not request any sensitive permission at the moment.

5. Deleting data
Uninstalling the App or clearing its data in system settings permanently deletes all records. The developer cannot recover them.

6. Children privacy
The App does not collect any information from children.

7. Changes
If a server or sign-in feature is added in the future, this policy will be updated and shown inside the App.

8. Contact
Questions about privacy: wan.business@qq.com.

Habit does not sell data, show ads, or profile you. Without signing in, everything stays on this phone. After signing in, your data is transferred securely and stored in your own cloud space.
Habit plans, point history, store rewards, achievements, language and theme. Stored in the app\'s private directory — unreadable by other apps, deleted on uninstall.

Only after you sign in, and only that same data, uploaded to your own Supabase space. Row Level Security isolates every record by login identity, so even with the public key others cannot read your rows.
No contacts, photos, location, SMS or call logs; no device identifiers, IMEI or MAC address; no analytics, no crash reporting, no ad SDKs. One third-party service is used, for sync only: Supabase.
Only INTERNET, used solely for sign-in, registration and sync. Everything else works offline.
· Export a backup: Settings → Data & backup · Delete your account: Profile → Sign out → Delete account (cloud and local data removed) · Use the app fully without an account
Questions or full data removal: wan.business@qq.com
